summary: A cheerful Svelte one-pager for Whirly Birdie (a 50s-advertising display variable font: wght, wdth, ital) and its companion Whirlybats (a dingbat font whose 'anim' axis animates 200+ pictograms). Flat mid-century illustration throughout: a city-skyline hero, a black tester panel with per-row sliders and a colour picker, an on-screen keyboard for the dingbats, an illustrated room built from glyphs, a PayPal package picker and a lavender sign-off stamp.

instances.look: On warm off-white, 'WHIRLY BIRDIE!' in a wide heavy cut with letters coloured black, red, blue and green, a red bird glyph perched above 'A NEW FONT!', and a flat illustrated city below: blue tower blocks holding signs ('ONE HOT FONT', 'PUNCHY TITLES', an animated sun and eye), a street with trees, a snail and a car
instances.ux: Name letters bob alternately up and down; Whirlybats signs animate; a round icon button top-left opens the section menu; custom glyph cursor
instances.learn: Build the hero illustration from the dingbat companion font itself (sun, eye, car, snail are glyphs), so the scene is also a specimen of the second font

reconstruction.layout: Full screen (100vh) plus the street running into the next screen; name centred, two lines spanning x≈290–1150 at y≈260–560; bird ~60px above; skyline of ~6 towers along the bottom edge, signs ~150×150px mounted on top; street row of 6 leaf-shaped trees at y≈1000–1150
reconstruction.typography: Name ~150px Whirly Birdie wide heavy (wght 100, wdth 150), caps-and-lowercase mix (WhIrly BIrdie!), each letter a different brand colour; 'A NEW FONT!' ~11px caps; sign lettering in Whirly Birdie at 40–58px (red on black, red on yellow), Whirlybats pictograms at 110px
reconstruction.behaviour: Each title char gets an alternating translateY of about ±5px in a loop (wobble); Whirlybats signs run 'basicAnimationDelay' keyframes (5–6s infinite) on the anim axis; car and snail on the street are glyphs (.car, .car2, .snail)
reconstruction.content: Name, 'A new Font!', and ad slogans on the signs (One Hot Font, Punchy Titles)
reconstruction.assets: SVG tower blocks and trees; everything else is font glyphs (two sign images failed to load in the capture and show alt text)

instances.look: A small white circular button fixed top-left showing a Whirlybats pictogram that changes with the section (gear, camera, pointing hand, piggy bank); never cut as its own block
instances.ux: Click opens a full-screen nav with four big entries: Whirly Birdie, Whirlybats, Playground, Buy Now! each flanked by a pictogram; the current one is marked selected
instances.learn: Let the menu button's icon be a dingbat that swaps per section: it doubles as a section indicator and a teaser of the dingbat font

reconstruction.layout: Button ~40px circle, fixed at 20px/20px; overlay nav fills the viewport with 4 stacked h2 rows
reconstruction.typography: Menu entries in Whirly Birdie at display size, letter spans with kerning classes (.kerny, .kernhalf); icons in Whirlybats
reconstruction.behaviour: Button toggles nav.hide; icon glyph changes per section in view
reconstruction.content: Whirly Birdie / Whirlybats / Playground / Buy Now!
reconstruction.html: button.wb-icon[type=button] + nav > .bg + h2(.selected) > span.wb-icon + span per letter

instances.look: Two small coloured info cards that introduce each font: a yellow card with a sun pictogram ('WHIRLY BIRDIE is a display typeface inspired by American advertising of the 50s…') and a navy card with a TV pictogram ('WHIRLYBATS is a dingbat font with a twist…'), each ending 'Try it below! ↓'
instances.ux: static; points down to the tool that follows
instances.learn: Introduce each font with a three-line card that ends in an arrow to the tester: the story is a caption for the playground, not a chapter

reconstruction.layout: Card ~620×250px centred on the section seam (x≈410–1030), big pictogram ~130px on the left, text column ~380px on the right
reconstruction.typography: Font name in Whirly Birdie wide (wght 70, wdth 150) caps, letter-spacing 2px; body ~17px Nicholson Beta at 55–70% opacity; 'Try it below! ↓' at full opacity
reconstruction.content: One-sentence positioning per font: 50s American advertising; anim axis used to animate 200+ glyphs instead of squish and squash

instances.look: A black panel inset on off-white with five editable ad slogans ('CORN FLAKES', 'REAL WHOLE GRAIN', 'STRAWBERRY GOODNESS', 'CAFÉ AROUND BACK →', 'ENHANCED WITH CHOCOLATE BITS'), each under a thin control bar: preset select + Weight, Width, Italic sliders with white rectangular thumbs; a sticky white card of five colour dots on the right edge
instances.ux: Pick a named preset or drag the three axis sliders per row (select switches to 'Custom'); type over any line; the colour dots recolour the panel (black, red, blue, yellow, green themes)
instances.learn: Seed each row with a different extreme of the design space (wide bold, narrow light, narrow italic) and a cereal-box slogan, so the default state is already a specimen

reconstruction.layout: Panel x=80–1360, ~3 screens tall; each row: control bar (select ~230×30px, then three ~170px sliders with 11px labels above) then the sample centred; rows ~450–600px apart; colour-picker card ~50×240px fixed on the right edge, white with 5 dots ~26px
reconstruction.typography: Samples Whirly Birdie at font-size 10vw, 12vw, 9vw, 8vw, 6vw (144, 173, 130, 115, 86px at 1440), all caps; initial settings wght 100/wdth 150, wght 50/wdth 50, wght 100/wdth 50, wght 75/wdth 50/ital 12, wght 50/wdth 110; labels ~11px sans
reconstruction.behaviour: input[type=range] wght 50–100, wdth 50–150, ital 0–20 write font-variation-settings on the row's p[contenteditable]; preset select sets all three; colour picker swaps CSS vars (--type/--bg) for the section
reconstruction.html: section > .controls > .select > select.type-presets (Regular, Italic, Bold, Light, Wide, Narrow… + hidden 'Custom') + .sliders > .slider > label + input.slider.weight|width|italic ; p[contenteditable][style=font-variation-settings;font-size:Nvw] ; .colorpicker.sticky > div[color=invert|red|blue|sun|green]

instances.look: On a blue field with drifting large pictograms, a white card shows one big animated Whirlybats glyph (a globe) above an on-screen QWERTY keyboard whose grey keys show the pictograms; the selected key is blue with its letter, plus shift and '123' keys and a space bar
instances.ux: Click a key (or type) to show that pictogram large, animated through its anim axis; shift and 123 switch the key layer; the large glyph is also contenteditable; colour dots recolour the card
instances.learn: For a dingbat font, render the keyboard itself: each key shows the picture it types, and the big preview plays the glyph's animation

reconstruction.behaviour: Selected glyph runs keyframes animating font-variation-settings 'anim' (e.g. 100 → 200, 1s linear infinite); key buttons set data-text of the featured p
reconstruction.content: Whirlybats pictograms mapped to a–z, caps and numerals

instances.look: 'Playground': a flat-illustrated mauve study: a bookshelf whose spines carry titles in different widths and weights (Silver Cave, Brave Stars, On the Trail, Liminal Zinc), a wall clock with Whirlybats pictograms for numerals, a card with a huge narrow 'A', a red lamp, a TV with a green waveform, a plant, and a desk with a computer and chair
instances.ux: Objects are glyphs and react when clicked or hovered (bounce containers, animated clock hands, a glyph-built computer and chair); the clock keeps real time
instances.learn: Furnish a room out of the two fonts: book spines show the text face's widths, and every object (clock face, chair, monitor) is a dingbat

reconstruction.content: Invented book titles; clock numbers replaced by pictograms

reconstruction.html: section.playground > .demo.col2.demo-1 (shelf > .book > .booktitle[style=font-variation-settings]) + .demo.col1.demo-2 (svg clock, text.num) + .demo-3 (svg text.letter) + .demo-4 (svg#desk with #computer/#seat in Whirlybats)
